Berserk: Double damage dealt and taken.
Bloodthirst: Whenever you deal damage, heal HP equal to unblocked damage. At the end of your turn, lose [blue]25%[/blue] of current HP.
Wither: At the start of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], and [gold]Frail[/gold]; lose [blue]1[/blue] energy.
Entering the fourth stage causes immediate death.
